title: Totals over the buckets measured by bucket-size

examined.description: Buckets with an entry in sizes

omitted.description: Buckets left out of the run by maxItems

complete.description: Every bucket of the target has a size (nothing omitted by maxItems, nothing failed, notMeasured is 0)

notMeasured.description: Buckets looked at that have no size: Cloud Monitoring has no series for them (project targets), or their read failed

totalBytes.description: Sum of sizeBytes over the buckets measured
